vllm-project_llm-compressor/src/llmcompr.initialize_observer: initialize observer module and attach it to a quantized torch.nn.Module for weight, input, or output calibration

vllm-project_llm-compressor/src/llmcompr.freeze_module_quantization: freeze a module's quantization by removing all attached observers and setting quantization status to FROZEN

vllm-project_llm-compressor/src/llmcompr.run_validate_with_bypass: run validate_group_size_divisibility with bypass=True to skip indivisibility checks for runtimes that support non-divisible dimensions
vllm-project_llm-compressor/src/llmcompr.review__layer_indivisible: review the _layer_indivisible helper function that checks if a module's weight columns are not divisible by group_size
vllm-project_llm-compressor/src/llmcompr.summarize_group_size_validation: summarize the group_size_validation module's policy for GROUP and TENSOR_GROUP quantization strategies requiring column divisibility
